gap.impact: No empirical routing probability or admission-policy default can be populated. AIHW reports a realized episode-end status, which is an outcome after the care episode rather than a decision-time route. The appendix says national emergency presentations had about 30% episode end status 'Admitted to this hospital'; referred-to-another-hospital-for-admission patients are excluded. This must not be used as a routing probability.
searches_performed: Inspected bound official AIHW Emergency department care 2024–25 Appendix PDF at page 8, Table A4 and the adjacent admitted-by-triage narrative; local PDF SHA-256 a7988e025d65a6a37b31c5b10403b35a718eb2d2b45607a947af82acabd6a53c.
Confirmed Table A4 reports emergency-presentation proportions by triage category and jurisdiction, not destination or pathway choices.

Checked the appendix narrative: it describes episode-end status 'Admitted to this hospital', gives approximate national and triage-specific proportions, and excludes patients referred to another hospital for admission; it points to main-report Tables 4.13 and 4.14, whose exact cells are not included in this appendix.

Compared with supplied report R3, SHA-256 304bbd2e30d8af34e002e1603c647860a110432a1a0e3ac68cbe8e5143db8eaf, lines 406–412, which identifies admission decision and specialty allocation as local measurements and warns that public statistics describe outcomes rather than primitive mechanisms.
gap.next_action: Obtain a source that observes the decision-time pathway choice set and eligible denominator, with conditioning variables and disposition status defined at that decision point. If pursuing the AIHW main-report tables, bind the exact edition and tables 4.13/4.14 as a separate bounded source check; retain those realized proportions only as outcome/comparability evidence. Record any later transformation and licence/access terms, then request independent source readback.

review.notes: Bound appendix bytes and cited page were inspected. The source supports triage mix and realized episode-end admission-status comparisons only; it does not establish decision-time routing probabilities or their denominator. No numeric policy, default, or route distribution is supplied. Coordinator review and independent source readback remain required.
